exact_statement: For Boolean signs on the uniform cube, with g=(f+1)/2, p=E g, v=Var(f), the exact unit mappings in CONVENTIONS.json hold: H_nats=ln(2)H_bits; I_spec(f)=4 I_spec(g); Hplus(f)=4 Ent_raw(ghat^2 on nonempty)-2v; H(f)=h2(v)+vH(P_nonempty/v)=Hplus(f)+E0; D=min_U I(chi_U f)<=4(I-v). For independent Bernoulli biases, spectral inclusion influence is 4p_i(1-p_i) times pivotal probability, and corrected Hcorr=Hplus+sum_i I_spec,i log2(4p_i(1-p_i)); biased dictators have Hcorr=I_spec-v=0. The C018 natural additive recombination constant is 2, its bit version 2/ln(2); no universal payment is asserted.
